name: Create a document from a template

elements.name: Toggle template grouping by document type

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the metric template folder is selected
a standard metric part template's details are displayed
the user clears Grouped by Type in the template display menu
the template gallery displays a flat collection without type group headings
the details pane continues to display the metric part template information
the user selects Grouped by Type in the template display menu
the gallery displays part, assembly and drawing group headings
the details pane continues to display the metric part template information
